create_sequence_generator: create a SequenceGenerator instance with a decoder, BOS, PAD, EOS tokens, and vocab size for beam search translation
run_generate_batch: run the generate method to produce beam-search translations for a batch of source sentences
run_generate_with_prefix: run generate with prefix_tokens to constrain the beginning of each generated translation
run_generate_sampling: run generate with sampling enabled to produce stochastic translations instead of beam search
review_sequence_generator: review the SequenceGenerator class and its beam search decoding logic with length penalty normalization
